name: System Constraints
description: System-level execution constraints (authorization-side, CLC-v1 §8.1). The core recognizes exactly the (scheme,type) pairs max_rows/time/network; any other type under this scheme is unknown_constraint (fail-closed).
author: varwof

value.description: Strict non-negative integer (JSON number grammar: no leading +, no 0x, no trailing characters)

window.description: Non-empty JSON array (<= 32 elements) of {"start":"HH:MM[:SS]","end":"HH:MM[:SS]"} segments, UTC, repeated daily; a single window = a one-element array; a single segment must have start < end within one day and must not cross midnight; end:"00:00" is reserved as next-day midnight; segments ascending and non-overlapping

cidr.description: JSON array (<= 32 elements) of legal IPv4/IPv6 CIDR strings ("addr/mask"), syntax-level check only
